item.title: GPT-4o context window increased to 256k tokens
item.description: GPT-4o now supports a 256,000 token context window for all API customers, up from 128,000. Pricing is unchanged.

item.title: Introducing structured outputs in the API
item.description: Structured Outputs guarantees model responses adhere to a supplied JSON Schema.
